quality.review_scope: Admitted main article only: all 15 pages independently read as text and actual images. Local main methods, variants, controls, comparisons and measurement contexts are retained. Downloaded-only supporting information is not admitted and was not opened, read or hashed. SI-only details are missing rather than inferred. Reference geometry is not a measured nanocrystal, interface or coordination model.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch identifiers are absent. Supporting information is not admitted/read; its additional experimental details are outside this scoped record.
Full unoptimized schedules, every figure-to-size recipe join, extra-OA dose, detailed 200 °C thiourea preparation and numerical spectral population fractions.
